title: Adventure
summary: A top-down adventure seen from above. Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Collect everything to win.

parts.what: CameraFollow keeps the hero in the middle of the screen as it moves.
parts.try: Change Smoothness: lower numbers make the camera lag behind more.

parts.what: Colliders with no RigidBody2D never move, so they block the way.
parts.try: Copy a Tree with Ctrl+D to make a maze.

parts.what: TopDownController moves in four directions with the arrow keys or WASD. Gravity Scale is 0 because this game is seen from above.
parts.try: Set Speed to 8, or turn on Face Movement so the hero turns where it walks.

parts.what: Collectible adds 1 to game.stars when the hero touches it.
parts.try: Change the Counter name on one of them to start a second kind of treasure.

parts.what: Hazard: stepping on it costs 1 health and pushes the hero away.
parts.try: Set Damage to 2 on one trap.

parts.what: Patrol walks back and forth along one axis (some go sideways, some up and down). Hazard hurts.
parts.try: Change a slime's Axis from X to Y.

parts.what: Its script (scripts/adventure_win.es) counts the Stars still in the level with count("star"). At zero, the message appears.
parts.try: Hide one more collectible somewhere hard to reach.

parts.what: ScoreDisplay shows game.stars on screen. Collectibles add to it when you pick them up.
parts.try: Change its Format, for example to "Loot: {}".
